title: Only Book Lovers Will Understand The Difficulty Of Keeping a Book Dry In A Bathtub!
text: Only Book Lovers Will Understand The Difficulty Of Keeping a Book Dry In A Bathtub!. Nice way to enjoy having your phone and book handy while you're in the tub! I have only one criticism. The metal book holder will not stay in any upright position for heavier books. I still use this product, though.
